name: Borana Weaves Ltd
tagline: 59% ROE water-jet greige-fabric compounder with a strong Q1 FY27 and phased loom expansion - but a SEBI search on a co-promoter JV and 25-80% related-party revenue made an early bull exit
business_overview: Borana Weaves (listed May 2025) manufactures unbleached grey (greige) fabric on water-jet looms and Polyester Texturised Yarn (PTY) in Surat, Gujarat. It is steadily raising the grey-fabric mix to ~90% (the value-added product); POY, a crude-linked derivative, is ~61% of the cost base. The company took organised-sector share from unorganised powerlooms by delivering on time and at scale (a water-jet loom produces 7-8x a powerloom). Capacity expansion is deliberately phased - Unit 4 (160 looms) live, a 192-machine block guided for Dec 2026, and management signalling further quarterly expansion announcements toward ~Rs 475-500 Cr annualised revenue.
fundamentals_table: ~48% CAGR; ~Rs 42 Cr (FY22) -> ~Rs 290 Cr (FY25); strong Q1 FY27 beat
fundamentals_narrative: On the numbers this is a standout: ~59% ROE, ~41% ROCE, ~48% revenue CAGR off a tiny base, and a Q1 FY27 result the thread called 'much better than expected' (~Rs 70 Cr revenue expectation beaten, 25-30% OPM guidance) despite raw-material and Surat labour disruptions. D/E ~0.97 is real leverage for a textile SME in a capex ramp. Margins are unusually high for greige fabric, which itself invites scrutiny given the related-party structure.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Thread notes two lower circuits in Apr 2026 on the West Asia crude spike, a fall from ~Rs 370 toward ~Rs 216-260, and the thread-starter's stated bear-case buy zone of ~Rs 260.
sentiment_summary: Read the full thread (15 substantive posts of 17), Feb 2026 to Aug 2026. It is effectively two contributors. gaurav (thread-starter, IT professional, no textile background) built the initial bull case - Indian textile tailwinds, anti-dumping probe on imported fabric, walk-the-talk capex (3.5 MW rooftop solar + 160 looms commissioned) - then progressively turned cautious on governance: promoter runs separate same-industry entities outside the listed co, related-party transactions running 25-80% of revenue, and in May 2026 he stated he was 'of a mind to exit' after SEBI searched co-promoter JV 'R&B Denims' (a Rawat-Khedia/Dalmia x Borana family venture) amid what he called an apparent stock-price-manipulation episode, with a 'vague' management explanation. A second contributor, gaurav_agarwal3, stayed constructive through Aug 2026, emphasising the demand recovery, softening POY prices ($70-75 crude), the disciplined phased expansion, and a strong Q1 FY27.
community_signal: No roster/trusted users. Highest-loved posts are low in absolute terms (gaurav's opener 3 loves; RPT-risk exchange with Maznah 2 loves each). The most decision-relevant signal is a thoughtful early bull (gaurav) moving toward the exit on governance, partially offset by another engaged holder staying in.
bse_notes: SEBI search on co-promoter joint venture 'R&B Denims' (May 2026) per a thread post; management issued what a forum member called a vague explanation of an apparent price-manipulation episode. Related-party revenue disclosed in the RHP at 25-80%. IPO institutional lock-in ended Feb 2026 (anchor investors exited the register). No confirmed SEBI action against Borana Weaves itself in the posts read.
bull_case: ~59% ROE, ~41% ROCE, ~48% revenue CAGR off a small base - textbook early-stage compounder metrics
Structural organised-vs-unorganised share shift in greige fabric; water-jet looms 7-8x more productive than powerlooms; anti-dumping probe on imported fabric a tailwind
Disciplined phased capacity expansion (Unit 4 live, 192 machines by Dec 2026, more guided) toward ~Rs 475-500 Cr annualised revenue at 25-30% OPM
Q1 FY27 materially beat expectations despite crude-linked input pressure and a local labour crisis - execution is holding
Small ~Rs 815 Cr market cap leaves room for a multi-bagger if the compounding and governance both hold
bear_case: Governance overhang: SEBI search on a co-promoter JV (R&B Denims) with an alleged price-manipulation angle and a management response the thread found unconvincing
Related-party transactions at 25-80% of revenue with promoter-owned same-industry entities outside the listed company - makes the unusually high margins hard to fully trust
A thoughtful early bull publicly moved toward exiting specifically on these CG issues
Crude/POY price linkage (POY ~61% of cost) means margins are exposed to oil shocks; two lower circuits already seen on a West Asia spike
D/E ~0.97 during an aggressive capex ramp; SME/small-cap liquidity and disclosure risk; <18 months listed with no long track record
verdict_headline: Fits the 10x frame on fundamentals and capacity runway, but conviction is LOW and unconfirmed until the co-promoter SEBI episode and the 25-80% related-party structure are cleaned up
